PseudoLearn has no global variables. Every algorithm, subprogram and method has its own scope, and inside it every branch of
and every loop body opens a smaller scope.

blocks.description: A large box for the process with the variable n, and inside it another for the If branch with the variable doble. From inside n is visible; from outside doble is not.

caption.text: Scopes nest like boxes. From inside you can see what is outside; from outside you cannot see what is inside.

runs.text: The names of subprograms and classes are registered before their bodies. That is why a subprogram can call another one declared further down, and two subprograms can call each other.

points.text: A name lives from its declaration to the end of its block.
Shadowing an outer name is valid, with a warning.
Subprograms can be called in any order.
